info.title: OpenBrowserUse HTTP API
info.description: Local single-owner API with one active browser, durable FIFO jobs, SSE replay, screenshots, export, lifecycle settings and visual cursor events. HTTP browser origins remain disabled; use a server-side client.

get.description: Authenticated SSE: replay committed events then tail without a gap. Last-Event-ID is run_id:sequence and overrides after. 15-second comment heartbeats; bounded buffering. Terminal runs close after replay. Reconnect from the last processed ID and deduplicate. Events follow the Event schema; oversized text has truncated=true. Legacy runs may only have a state snapshot.
